title: "FLS2 Project Extra Credit"
---

```{r}
## Plot for Visualizing Taxonomic Rank

library(ggplot2)

# Taxonomic information
taxonomy <- data.frame(
  rank = c(
    "Domain",
    "Kingdom",
    "Clade",
    "Phylum",
    "Class",
    "Order",
    "Family",
    "Genus",
    "Species"
  ),
  name = c(
    "Eukaryota",
    "Plantae",
    "Angiosperms",
    "Tracheophyta",
    "Magnoliopsida",
    "Solanales",
    "Solanaceae",
    "Nicotiana",
    "Nicotiana benthamiana"
  ),
  y = 9:1
)

# Box dimensions
box_width <- 1.0
box_height <- 0.62

ggplot(taxonomy, aes(x = 0, y = y)) +
  
  # Connecting line
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = 0,
      y = y - box_height / 2,
      yend = y - 1 + box_height / 2
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "#4A5568"
  ) +
  
  # White boxes
  geom_tile(
    width = box_width,
    height = box_height,
    fill = "white",
    color = "#243447",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # Angiosperm box highlighted
  geom_tile(
    data = taxonomy[taxonomy$rank == "Clade", ],
    width = box_width,
    height = box_height,
    fill = "#DCEFF0",
    color = "#2F6F73",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # Rank labels
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = y + 0.12,
      label = rank
    ),
    size = 3.3,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#243447"
  ) +
  
  # Taxon names
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = y - 0.12,
      label = name
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "#243447"
  ) +
  
  # Italicize species
  geom_text(
    data = taxonomy[taxonomy$rank == "Species", ],
    aes(
      y = y - 0.12,
      label = name
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "#243447"
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    ylim = c(0.35, 9.65)
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )
```
